novelty.exact_request_url_deduplication: The exact market-inventory URL and three exact bounded funding-history URLs had zero retained contract result journal raw or prose hits before freeze.

question: Does a fixed BTC ETH or SOL Binance-versus-Paradex perpetual orientation retain positive direction-neutral funding carry in training validation and test after all frozen hurdles?

official_semantics.funding_history: Paradex production API documents public GET /v1/funding/data with exact market start_at and end_at millisecond bounds page_size up to 5000 and created_at funding_period_hours funding_rate and funding_rate_8h fields.
official_semantics.instrument_identity: Paradex production GET /v1/markets exposes symbol asset_kind base_currency quote_currency settlement_currency funding_period_hours open_at expiry_at and trading_mode.
official_semantics.cash_flow: Paradex official funding terms define an eight-hour reference rate with continuous pro-rata accrual and state that positive funding is paid by longs to shorts. Positive signed rates therefore match Binance orientation.
official_semantics.structural_dependence: Paradex derives its published funding rate from a weighted median of Paradex Binance Bybit OKX Lighter and Hyperliquid impact premiums. This test seeks only a settlement timing or smoothing spread and does not treat Paradex as an independent signal.
official_semantics.sampling_boundary: Historical funding_rate_8h observations are normalized to hourly fractions and eight consecutive hourly observations are summed for each Binance eight-hour bucket. Because the public history is sampled rather than the exact realized account index delta this run is rejection or prioritization only and every role pays a separate 10-bip sampling stress.
official_semantics.execution_hurdle: The funding-only prefilter charges 20 bips round trip before any account-specific fee claim plus explicit capital quote-unit custody latency and sampling stresses. A survivor requires a disjoint exact-index and synchronized finite-size basis and depth study.

population.paradex_bucket_semantics: sum funding_rate_8h divided by eight for exact hourly timestamps t_minus_7h through t inclusive against Binance funding bucket t
population.instrument_gate: Each exact Paradex symbol must occur once as a STANDARD PERP with matching base currency quote USD settlement USDC funding period 8 hours open no later than the first bucket and expiry_at zero.

orientation: Choose sign once from the training aggregate of Paradex normalized funding minus Binance funding. A positive aggregate fixes short Paradex and long Binance; a negative aggregate fixes long Paradex and short Binance. Never refit validation or test.

decision.failure: Terminalize the exact 90-bin population before premiums books accounts credentials orders or funds; do not resample or alter roles orientation alignment or costs.
decision.survivor: Freeze a disjoint exact current Paradex funding-index confirmation plus venue fees and synchronized finite-size entry and exit basis and depth evidence. A survivor is not yet an accepted edge or deployment-ready.

retry_policy: One exact inventory GET and one exact bounded funding GET per asset only. Preserve every terminal response. Never paginate alias reorder narrow substitute a host or retry after seeing values.
